candidates.name: W.H. Cress Company, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage calls it a 'Commercial Building Specialties Distributor & Subcontractor' and an 'installation company' with washroom partitions as its primary product; manufacturers page lists Bobrick, ASI and Ironwood partitions. Project list (Portland, Beaverton, Lake Oswego, Woodburn jobs) does not say partitions were installed; no partition install photos seen.
red_flags: Distributor of partitions (Bobrick, ASI): buy-around risk
No explicit statement or photos of partition installation
No public email on site (form only)
candidates.reason: Portland-metro Division 10 distributor and subcontractor whose main product is washroom partitions and which calls itself an installation company, but partition installation is not shown explicitly. Also a direct partition seller, so a buy-around risk.

license.name: W.H. Cress Company, Inc.
license.registry: Oregon Construction Contractors Board (CCB) active license data, published on data.oregon.gov (dataset g77e-6bhs)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. The CCB record lists 'WH CRESS COMPANY INC' in Tigard (Washington County). The license was first registered 01/16/1990 and expires 01/16/2027. Bond: $25,000 with Ohio Casualty, expiring 01/16/2027. Liability insurance: $1,000,000 with The Cincinnati Ins Co, expiring 01/01/2027. RMI: Scott Philip Cress. The record lists phone 503-620-1664. The record comes from the CCB active-licenses open dataset. The interactive search at search.ccb.state.or.us needs a form postback, and a direct details URL returned no record, so it was not used. The company website (https://www.whcress.com/) says its primary specialty is commercial washroom partitions and accessories. It describes the company as a distributor and installation company, with HQ in Portland and an address in Tigard. The website shows no CCB number. Portland has no city contractor license, so the state CCB license is the record that applies. The third-party site ccblookup.com shows the same data, but it is not official.
